holder-quote: The spells crackled from Falene’s staff, as fast as she could chant.
effect-quote: The flames and orb of lightning burst across one Gargoyle’s face, forcing the huge creature made of living rock to rear back as the spells struck its sensitive eyes.

holder-quote: Isceil, howling, pointed a wand at Erin, barely able to see. He roared.
effect-quote: She dodged the spell as a crackling orb of lightning shot past her shoulder. Relc slashed at it and cut the orb in half as he charged.
